name: Chongqing VDL Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing VDL Electronics Co., Ltd. is a company that specializes in producing small-scale lithium batteries for the consumer electronics sector. Their offerings include a range of rechargeable power cells, such as coin, square pouch, and cylindrical pouch types. The company was established in 2007 and conducts its operations from Chongqing, China.
